concept: A young mechanic's resourceful salvage-and-spares trader: a compact working hauler assembled from sound reclaimed hardware.
silhouette: Broad compact workboat with two blunt forward cradle rails, offset port wheelhouse, starboard folded utility arm and two differently housed aft drives.
trading_role: Buying surplus ship equipment, rebuilding useful components and trading them between frontier colonies.
design_brief:
DESIGN — SECOND WIND, owned by the redesigned 32-year-old mechanic and trader Mags Halloran:
A compact independent salvage-and-spares trading workboat, cleverly rebuilt from several generations of serviceable hardware. Resourceful and lovingly maintained. The repairs make structural sense: it is an operational small business, not a wreck or a heap of junk.
Silhouette: a BROAD, SHORT, CHUNKY working hull, length-to-width about 1.45:1, noticeably less slender than ordinary couriers. Two short blunt parallel forward cradle rails flank one rectangular equipment pallet locked firmly between them. An OFFSET PORT-SIDE WHEELHOUSE rises just behind the left cradle rail; the opposite starboard shoulder carries one stowed articulated utility crane. The crane ends in a compact two-jaw tool gripper and is recognizably lifting equipment, never a cannon.
The central low rectangular WORKSHOP/CARGO HULL has one large roof service hatch with a copper-orange frame. Exactly TWO chunky drives at the stern, symmetrically placed about the centerline for balanced thrust and at the same height. Their outlet diameters are equal: the PORT drive has an older rounded cylindrical casing, the STARBOARD drive has a newer box-shaped casing around its circular nozzle. Do not add a third engine. Exactly ONE circular customer docking collar midway along the port side, below and behind the wheelhouse. The starboard side instead has a reinforced cargo-loading hatch under the stowed crane.
Built-in spare-part lockers, bolted repair plates and visible structural braces are large enough to read and remain orderly. Keep the forward pallet attached as part of the ship's loaded silhouette in all views. The ventral view shows substantial keel rails, closed loading doors and patched access panels, not the dorsal wheelhouse or crane painted underneath. In the port SIDE view the opposite folded crane may be naturally partly hidden. All asymmetric parts must retain their true physical sides in every view.
Palette: weathered moss-green main plating, warm ivory replacement sections, a few rust-orange REPAINTED panels and copper fittings over charcoal framing. Patchwork is intentional color variation, not flaking rust or grime. Mild scuffs at edges, clean intact windows and seams, warm cabin windows, small cool-blue navigation lights. No fabric canopy, no purple stripes, no scattered debris.
The distinctive read is a squat, slightly asymmetric mechanical workboat with a cargo cradle, tidy repairs and an offset wheelhouse.
Exact text: SECOND WIND, TOP, BOTTOM, FRONT, BACK, SIDE.
initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one fully textured FIVE-VIEW 2D orthographic spaceship concept reference sheet for Stellar Syndicates, intended to establish a new character's trading ship before 3D modeling.
Input image 1 is an EXISTING fleet sheet, used only for presentation, material rendering, readable hard-surface detail and technical illustration style. Invent the requested NEW hull. Do not copy that reference ship's bow, striped canopy, market-deck silhouette or proportions.
Presentation: wide 2:1 landscape sheet on opaque white. Exactly FIVE views of the SAME physically coherent new ship. On the left 58%, two large vertical plans side by side: TOP, then BOTTOM, both with the nose pointing exactly UP. On the right 42%, FRONT above BACK above SIDE; the SIDE view points nose LEFT. A clear dark-slate uppercase ship title above the drawings. Small dark-slate uppercase labels TOP, BOTTOM, FRONT, BACK, SIDE, exactly once each. No perspective hero, inset or sixth view. Keep every view fully visible, with generous white gutters, no overlap and no cropped components.
Projection: true orthographic parallel projection throughout. TOP and BOTTOM must have the same outer physical hull dimensions and component stations. Dedicated ventral plating on BOTTOM, not copied dorsal features. FRONT and BACK are true end-on, zero-pitch elevations with no visible broad top deck. SIDE is a flat zero-pitch profile, not a three-quarter view. Engines point aft in every projection. Only BACK shows full circular or rectangular exhaust openings. TOP shows engine walls and thin aft nozzle rims, not exhausts tilted upward. All docking collars face outward sideways. Preserve exact counts and positions of major parts across views. Physically asymmetric parts must swap screen sides between TOP and BOTTOM as appropriate while retaining their actual port/starboard location.
Art direction: precise colored hard-surface technical concept illustration matching the supplied fleet sheet. Clean readable large shapes, restrained secondary panel detail, crisp contours, believable plates, seams, access hatches, glass and metal. Soft neutral illumination, consistent material colors across views, only tiny engine-aperture and navigation-light glows. Ship personality comes from geometry and livery. No scenery, stars, hangar, smoke, trails, ground shadows, blueprint grid or dimension lines.
Civilian merchant: UNARMED. No guns, turrets, missiles, military emblems, pointed weapons, people or docked extra spacecraft. No recognizable franchise vessel. No logos, registration numbers, hull writing, random glyphs or watermark. Render only the exact title and five view labels.
Output one finished opaque PNG, 2:1 landscape, target 3072 x 1536 at the highest native detail available.

revisions.purpose: Align asymmetric bridge, crane and docking collar in opposite views.
revisions.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
The attached image is the EDIT TARGET: the SECOND WIND five-view spaceship concept reference sheet.
Keep the design, colors, materials, weathering, scale, title, five view labels, white background, spacing and all component counts exactly as they are. The TOP drawing at far left is the authoritative physical layout. Keep TOP and SIDE unchanged.
Correct only the handedness of THREE drawings: horizontally reflect the ship artwork within BOTTOM, FRONT and BACK, each within its own existing view area. Do NOT mirror or move any text. Keep their label text upright and readable.
Reason and required resulting consistency: in TOP the wheelhouse and circular customer docking collar are on physical PORT (screen left), with the utility crane on physical STARBOARD (screen right). Therefore FRONT must show the wheelhouse and docking collar on the viewer's RIGHT and crane on the viewer's LEFT. BACK must show the wheelhouse and collar on the viewer's LEFT and crane on the viewer's RIGHT. BOTTOM, with the nose still pointing UP, must put the port docking collar on screen RIGHT, with the two differently housed engines and all asymmetric underside detail correspondingly reflected. Make those three ship drawings left-right reflections of their current artwork, not new designs.
Do not add, remove, redesign or relocate any individual physical part. Preserve exactly two engine outlets, one port docking collar, the forward locked cargo pallet, offset wheelhouse and folded crane. Do not change TOP, SIDE, title, labels or sheet layout.
Output the same opaque 2:1 landscape five-view reference sheet at native detail. Text remains exactly SECOND WIND, TOP, BOTTOM, FRONT, BACK, SIDE.

revisions.purpose: Correct the rear engine casing assignments.
revisions.prompt: Edit this SECOND WIND spaceship reference sheet with one extremely local correction. Preserve the exact canvas, white background, title, all five labels, TOP, BOTTOM, FRONT, SIDE, and every other visible element unchanged. In the BACK drawing at middle right ONLY, correct the two exterior engine casings to match the TOP: the viewer-left engine (port, under the bridge) needs the ROUND cylindrical green/ivory/orange casing currently shown on the viewer-right; the viewer-right engine (starboard, under the crane) needs the SQUARE boxy ivory/green casing currently shown on the viewer-left. Swap only their casing shapes and their associated outer colored panels. Keep both circular blue exhaust apertures centered in their existing positions, the same equal size and brightness. Keep the bridge on viewer-left and crane on viewer-right in this BACK drawing exactly as they are. Do not mirror any drawing. Do not shift or redesign the hull, bridge, crane, center stern or the other four views. The final BACK view must have a rounded engine housing on the left and a box-shaped engine housing on the right, consistent with TOP. Opaque white background, same crisp painted 2D concept-reference style and original sheet proportions.

revisions.purpose: Restore the starboard exhaust as a rear-facing blue circular aperture.
revisions.prompt: Make one surgical visual correction to this spaceship reference image. Change ONLY the RIGHT ENGINE IN THE "BACK" VIEW (the middle-right spaceship drawing, immediately above the BACK label). This right engine currently mistakenly shows its top panel and a downward-facing black nozzle. Replace that engine with the REAR-FACING END of the same engine: a LARGE, PERFECTLY CIRCULAR, BRIGHT CYAN-BLUE EXHAUST APERTURE looking straight toward the viewer, surrounded by dark concentric rings, all inside a SQUARE cream-and-olive engine housing with clipped corners and orange details. Match the visible nozzle size, concentric-ring construction, brightness and face-on perspective of the LEFT engine in this same BACK view. Two equal large blue circles must be clearly visible side by side in the BACK view. The RIGHT exterior casing should be square, with the blue round nozzle centered within it; there must be no top panel blocking the nozzle and no downward-facing nozzle. Keep the LEFT engine exactly as it is, keep the bridge on left and crane on right, and keep the whole remainder of the canvas pixel-faithful: the TOP, BOTTOM, FRONT, SIDE drawings and all text unchanged. Do not add views. Same opaque white background, painted technical concept style, original sheet proportions.

output_handling: Native generated PNG copied without resizing or pixel edits; original retained.
review_notes: Five-view concept sheet visually reviewed for character, silhouette, palette and major features. Resolve exact proportions and small surface details during 3D modelling.
